name: Is breathwork suitable for beginners or those with no prior fitness experience?
description: Yes, breathwork is suitable for beginners and those new to fitness, with instructors guiding foundational techniques adapted to comfort levels.

mainEntity.name: Is breathwork suitable for beginners or those with no prior fitness experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, breathwork is highly suitable for beginners, including those new to fitness. Our instructors at Cave Training can guide you through foundational techniques, adapting exercises to your current comfort level. It's a low-impact practice that focuses on internal control, making it accessible to individuals of all fitness backgrounds. Starting with simple diaphragmatic breathing can help establish a strong base before progressing to more advanced techniques.
